subject: ISO audit windows + evidence buckets — intake options
messages:
From: Kate Li <kate.li@acmecorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ISO intake — scheduling & evidence buckets

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme's internal security team is coordinating a scoped ISO 27001 readiness review and we'd like to lock down a short intake before we issue the formal auditor request. A few quick questions up front so we can decide on the audit window: 

- Do you have suggested windows in July/August when Redwood can gate a focused evidence intake (2–3 working days) vs. a full audit window?
- Can you provide a short list of "evidence buckets" (examples: config snapshots, user access lists, MFA proofs, sample logs, third-party contracts) and preferred file formats?
- Will you require access to a demo/staging environment or is sanitized exports/samples sufficient?
- Who are the preferred control owners we should contact for operational controls and network diagrams?

We prefer July but are flexible. The auditor (BlueSky) will want a manifest and a point of contact for each control.

Thanks — can you reply with the options and any manifest template you use?

Best,
Kate Li
Security Program Manager
ACME Corp

Attachments: none

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Li <kate.li@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, BlueSky Audits <audits@bluesky-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO intake — scheduling & evidence buckets

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear list. Below are two practical intake options and the evidence buckets we can provide; I attached an evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx and an iso_scope_matrix.csv to help map requests to control owners.

Proposed intake windows (choose one):
- Option A: July 12–14 (2 full intake days + 1 buffer day) — best for minimal disruption
- Option B: Aug 3–6 (4 days) — safer if you need deeper sampling from logs

Evidence buckets we typically deliver (common formats in parentheses):
1) Configuration exports (JSON/HTML) — IAM policies, firewall rules, infra-as-code templates
2) Access & identity (CSV/PDF) — user lists, MFA proofs, SSO audit events
3) Operational logs (gz/ndjson) — sample retention windows and sampling pointers
4) Change & deployment records (PDF/CSV) — PR history, deployment approvals
5) Contracts & attestations (PDF) — third-party contracts and subprocessors list
6) Network diagrams & topology (PDF, Visio on request)
7) Evidence narratives (DOCX/PDF) — brief control narratives for auditors

Sanitized samples: we prefer to provide exports and sampled logs (redacted) rather than giving direct staging access. If BlueSky needs live access for a walkthrough we can arrange a constrained session, but it needs advance scheduling and an NDA addendum.

Control owners: the attached iso_scope_matrix maps most controls to owners; to call out the pieces you asked for, lead owners will be:
- Network/architecture diagrams: Marcus Lin
- Identity & access questions: Kimberly Park
- Evidence intake coordination: me (Mina Haddad)

Next steps I propose: Kate/BlueSky confirm preferred window, we finalize the manifest template (see attached), and we run a short dry-run (1 hour) with the control owners 3–5 business days before the intake.

Please confirm which option you prefer and whether you need additional buckets (e.g., cryptographic key inventories, HSM/KMS attestations).

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet listing sample items), iso_scope_matrix.csv (control→owner mapping)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Li <kate.li@acmecorp.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO intake — scheduling & evidence buckets

Hi all — quick clarifications from engineering/security ops: 

- We don't require a demo/staging access for the intake — redacted exports + sampled logs are sufficient in almost all cases.
- For operational logs, please confirm the sample window you want (30/60/90 days). Our default is 30 days; longer windows require a longer intake.
- Marcus will own the network topology; we can attach a high-level diagram in PDF ahead of the intake.
- Regarding KV cache and ephemeral logs: we can provide request-level traces for a sampling period but not full raw traffic dumps.

Mina — happy to join the dry-run and to own identity/access questions during the intake.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

1) Can you attach the high-level network-topology.pdf and confirm availability the week of Jul 12 if we pick Option A?
2) We need three named control owners for the intake who can join the two intake days and the dry-run (30–60 minute prep). Current suggestions (please confirm or replace):
   - Network/architecture: Marcus Lin
   - Identity & access: Kimberly Park
   - Change & deployment controls: Marcus Lin / (alternate: DevOps lead)
